name: final-ii-28l-zs-singles
note: Ruler final table priority (ii), 28L retrain set (torch 2.9.1 training; official eval in the pipeline venv). Code @ref-0171. Executor fills __URI_<member>__ = <retrain VM out>/babylm/runs/<member>/score/hf and __MIX_REF_pXY__ = the reads/rt28 full raw mixture DEV. GLUE is sequential (FT_PARALLEL=0): the S identity check was MISMATCH on multirc (ftverify @ref-0194), so no concurrent GLUE and no 28L identity check. Guard caveat: MIX_REF comes from the retrain VM's twin (torch 2.9.1); the guard recomputes it in the pipeline venv; a FAIL at |diff| ~1e-5..1e-4 would be a torch-eval difference, report it before voiding. bin ZS-SINGLES: official zero-shot (ZS_ONLY) of 28L e6 s0-s2, right after bin ZS (the first x0 VM died in setup before these ran). maxdur 1. Pool ruler.
